1 (Currently Amended): A method of cementing comprising: providing a cement composition comprising a __modified__ carboxylated inulin; and allowing the cement composition to set.

6 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the modified carboxylated inulin is derived from an inulin having an average molecular weight of about 500 or higher and is treated with a specific modification process.

7 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the modified carboxylated inulin comprises __a type of__ carboxymethylated inulin that is processed differently than that disclosed in Barlet-Gouedard et al.

10 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition further comprises __different types of__ borate salts, an organic acid comprising an alpha-hydroxycarboxylic acid, a synthetic polymer comprising a carboxylate group, or any combination thereof.

13 (Currently Amended): A method of cementing in a subterranean formation comprising: providing a cement composition comprising a modified carboxylated inulin; placing the cement composition in the subterranean formation; and allowing the cement composition to set therein.
